verdict.rationale: Anrok's API docs give explicit refund workflows. Full refunds use createOrUpdate with a negative transaction, and partial refunds use createNegation plus a new transaction version. Transactions are saved and associated with the appropriate tax return, void removes finalized transactions from a return, and filings are handled and fetchable. missing for 10: explicit documentation that negative amounts net against liability in the next filing period after a return is finalized, explicit credit-note terminology or handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
